assessment: Ready within the reviewed local static scope; browser and interaction acceptance remain unverified.

frozenOriginals.sourceAuthoringAndCompiledPayloads: Both complete texts match byte-for-byte after JSON decoding; six complete narrative sections and original lead are retained.
frozenOriginals.historicalLedger: Preparation-time statements are preserved and explicitly explained as historical.

firstCommitBinding.basis: Matches the supplied immutable commit identity, timestamp, local freeze metadata, compiled article and fixed source URLs; this local audit did not independently contact GitHub.

diagramOne.meaning: Author three-stage qualitative decision framework, not observed outcomes or a reconstruction of the product algorithm.
diagramOne.accuracy87: Vendor claim only; denominator unspecified; adoption and report counts are explicitly not substitute denominators. Both external sources have the same publisher.

diagramTwo.independentMethod: Recomputed directly from Decimal inputs without importing or executing the supplied calculation helper.
diagramTwo.scope: All inputs are author assumptions. Results are rent-premium differences, not whole-store profit, payback or measured AI effect. Accuracy 87% is not a calculation input.
diagramTwo.signsAndScale: Signed display values match reviewed rows; horizontal numeric axis retains both negative and positive values and includes zero in the official renderer.

sourceBinding.details: Reviewed rows, stable query/component IDs, metric definitions, formula, calculation-method text and fixed-commit evidence URLs agree across source, compiled article and snapshot. Source previews have no external image assets.

relativeLinkResolution.scope: Static URL resolution and render-call inspection only; no network destination verification.

singleArticleScope.details: Only the selected research article ID is present in compiled authored data; the existing site-fitout study is an intentional source link, not another embedded article. Unused official starter helpers are not another research payload.

officialRuntimeIntegrity.details: Protected verifier was run; compiled embedded runtime matches its declared hash and build manifest. No official infrastructure was changed.

buildAndPayload.details: Split-build HTML and snapshot byte sizes and hashes match their manifest; decoded offline snapshot equals the complete reviewed source snapshot; offline compiled catalog and story equal reviewed authoring inputs.

privacy.details: No matches in decoded authored data, compiled scripts including the embedded runtime, article source files or snapshot. No packaged owner identity, hosting project binding or local authoring-thread metadata. This is a scoped static scan, not a guarantee against every possible secret format.

externalAssetDependencies.details: HTML resource tags are embedded data assets only; CSS has no external URLs or imports; complete snapshot and runtime are embedded. Official optional network features are retained, so this does not assert that every possible interaction is network-free.

languageMetadata.details: The authored article declares zh-CN in source and compiled payload. The unchanged official document root uses en; the article-level language governs the Chinese reading content.

boundaries: Local static file and privacy audit only. No browsing, server, network request, upload, publication, repository change or modification to frozen source texts. Static checks cannot establish visual or interaction acceptance.
